plugin.note: Iron dragon strategy: weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; dragonbane weapons are best. Cannon Iron dragons when chasing draconic visage.

requirements: Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I
Cannon if using Brimhaven or Isle of Souls
mechanics: Metallic dragonfire is not blocked by Protect from Magic.
Iron dragons use melee and long-range dragonfire.
Iron dragons can drop the draconic visage.
Catacombs Iron dragons are stronger and can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
requiredOrKeyItems: Antifire potion or super antifire potion
steps: Use anti-dragon shield plus antifire, or super antifire.
Do not rely on Protect from Magic for metallic dragonfire.
Use Protect from Melee if fighting in melee range.

methods.label: Visage cannon
methods.summary: Cannon Iron dragons when seeking the draconic visage while keeping the task easier than higher Metal dragons.
steps: Use Brimhaven or Isle of Souls for cannon support.
Use dragonbane, stab, heavy ranged, or earth spell damage.
Use Catacombs only when Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces matter.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance or other stab weapon.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow or heavy ranged setup.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter wand or earth spell setup.

body:
# Iron dragon

Weak to stab, heavy ranged, and Earth spells; very high Defence. Dragon hunter lance is best stab versus draconic creatures, then fang. Do not use slash.
